title: Ivo and the Archive
author: Mirabel Hartwell
blurb: Wren Delacroix, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
